title: UNACCEPTABLE!!!!!!
text: I was excited to receive my Marvel Corps subscription. I had wanted to get one in the past but opted not to since I was carrying three Loot Crate subscriptions. I cancelled those subscriptions replacing them with this one. WHAT A HUGE MISTAKE! This box IS NOT worth the value I lost being a subscription holder with Loot Crate. If the next box is not an improvement over these last two, I will be yet another member to cancel their subscription. Come on Amazon, Marvel Studios, and Funko YOU HAVE TO AND CAN DO BETTER THAN THIS!!!
label: negative
